historic_survey.note: Built as the Infant Shelter and now the San Francisco Conservatory of Music to designs by Louis Christian Mullgardt — an institutional Mission Revival building that keeps a high level of integrity, with red tile roofs, shaped parapets in stucco, an unusual bell tower at the entrance and carved stonework around the entry.
